rules.title: Provenance
rules.statement: Any verified clinical extraction must link to exact source evidence; unsupported content remains inferred or unresolved.

rules.title: Patient attribution
rules.statement: Never assign another patient's or family member's report to the index patient.

rules.title: Drug-event relationship
rules.statement: Co-occurrence is not evidence of causality; keep reported suspect status separate from algorithmic conclusion.

rules.title: Document completeness
rules.statement: Missing full text, missing OCR pages and parse failures cannot silently produce clinical negatives.

rules.title: Knowledge applicability
rules.statement: Only approved rules matching tenant, client, jurisdiction, product and effective date may drive clinical decisions.

rules.title: Version pinning
rules.statement: All cooperating agents in one assessment must use one pinned, auditable knowledge snapshot.

rules.title: Term normalization
rules.statement: Keep verbatim product/event/medical history terminology alongside licensed normalized terms, preserving uncertainty.

rules.title: Safe abstention
rules.statement: Missing mandatory knowledge, contradictory evidence or tool failure means review required rather than unsupported certainty.
